title: Harness State DTO and Client Model

text.insert: lib hydrates HarnessStateView as the canonical client snapshot. It preserves game

revision, nullable summaries, queue order, blockers, freshness, operations, recent accepted events, and action projections without recomputing harness state. Harness state is the harness's per-game coordination record for revision, dispatch-lease holder, queued requests, and blockers.
The canonical field and ActionProjection contracts are owned by
; this client document owns hydration and revision-coherent replacement only.
Refresh replaces the snapshot coherently. Client types do not infer action authority or lease ownership from process flags.
